questions.q: According to Pressfield, what color represents fear for amateurs?
questions.why: He says fear is the primary color of the amateur's interior world.

questions.q: What does Pressfield call the false careers amateurs pursue?
questions.why: He refers to them as 'shadow careers.'

questions.q: What is a major pitfall when seeking guidance, per Pressfield?
a: Worshipping mentors and losing personal power
Following only one source of advice
questions.why: He warns that worshipping teachers takes away our power.

questions.q: At what age did Pressfield publish his first book?
questions.why: He published his first book at 52 after writing since his twenties.

questions.q: What does Pressfield say defines a professional's work ethic?
a: Doing work for its own sake as practice
questions.why: He states a pro works for the practice itself.
